description: Check which licence a use needs, and what it costs, for a small, hand-checked set of fonts: Pangram Pangram’s Font Starter Packs, Fontwerk Push, Grilli Type GT Cinetype and Fontfabric Nexa (6 offers). Use this when the user asks whether one of these fonts can be used on a website, on desktop, in print, in an app or game, in a logo or in paid ads, and what licence and price that needs: users, websites, monthly pageviews or unique visitors per site, years of use. Returns each offer’s published price where one applies, which requirements fail or are unconfirmed (for example pageview caps, PV versus UV, styles chosen at the foundry) and the foundry’s page. Other typefaces are not covered; say so instead of guessing. Published prices; nothing is bought.

goal.description: How to rank: lowest_cash_now = least money to pay now for whole packs or plans; lowest_job_cost = lowest cost allocated to this job (leftover credits keep their value); best_requirement_fit = best match to the stated use first.

lang.description: Language of the Formquote page linked in the answer (en, zh, ja, fr, de). The figures are the same; notes recorded by Formquote stay in their original language (mostly Chinese).

license_use.description: web (webfonts on a site), desktop (installed for design work) or both.

medium.description: Where it is used. A plain website licence does not cover a web app, app, game, logo or paid ads.

monthly_pageviews.description: Traffic cap needed per website per month, in the unit of traffic_metric (default 5,000).

requires_all_styles.description: Does the user need every weight and style of the family? (optional)

seats.description: People who will use the font (default 1).

term_years.description: Years the font will be used (default 1). Yearly plans only confirm the first year’s price.

traffic_metric.description: pv = pageviews, uv = unique visitors. They are not converted into each other.

websites.description: Websites the font will be used on (default 1).
